arguments.stem: The shop closes at six. You plan to go at five. Which Mandarin reply explains that plan?
arguments.answerA: 商店六点关门，所以我们五点去。
arguments.answerB: 商店五点关门，所以我们六点去。
arguments.answerC: 商店六点开门，所以我们五点去。
arguments.answerD: 商店五点开门，所以我们六点去。
arguments.feedback: The reply links closing at six to going at five. The alternatives change the times or describe opening instead of closing.
